categorisation: This gazette content involves the exercise of powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize purposes for specific societies and limit the application of the ordinance to them. It constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter. While it names Mahinda Rajapaksa as the authority, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only stating his title) and the primary focus is on regulatory implementation rather than government personnel or structural changes.
